privacy.controller.title: Controller
privacy.controller.p1: The controller responsible for processing your data is Matthias Watzinger, Aigen 27, 4710 Hofkirchen an der Trattnach, Austria. Lumina Chronica is a private, non-commercial project.
privacy.controller.p2: For any privacy question, reach us at luminachronica@gmx.at.
privacy.overview.title: At a glance
privacy.overview.p1: We only process the data Lumina Chronica needs to work:
privacy.overview.li1: no advertising, no analytics or tracking tools;
privacy.overview.li2: no cookies – only browser storage the app itself needs;
privacy.overview.li3: your books and projects are private until you publish or share them yourself;
privacy.overview.li4: we never sell data and only pass it to the service providers named below that we need to run the app.
privacy.hosting.title: Hosting and server logs
privacy.hosting.p1: The app itself (program files, images, fonts) is served via GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., USA). When you open it, GitHub processes technically necessary connection data such as your IP address, the time and your browser identifier to deliver the page and protect it against attacks.
privacy.hosting.p2: Accounts, books, projects and all other data are hosted by Cloudflare (Cloudflare, Inc., USA): the server functions run on Cloudflare Workers, the data lives in the Cloudflare D1 database and files in Cloudflare R2 storage. Cloudflare processes connection data as well. Our own logs only record method, path, status code and duration of each request – no IP addresses and no content.
privacy.hosting.p3: The legal basis is our legitimate interest in secure and stable operation (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.account.title: Your account
privacy.account.p1: For an account we store your username, email address and password – the password never in plain text, only as a salted, key-stretched hash (PBKDF2). Optionally a profile picture, your language, theme and other settings are added. The legal basis is providing the service you want to use (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
privacy.account.p2: If you sign in with Google or GitHub, the provider gives us an identifier, your email address, your name or username and possibly the address of your profile picture there. When that picture is shown, your browser loads it directly from the provider. The provider's own privacy policy applies to signing in there.
privacy.content.title: Your content
privacy.content.p1: We store what you create in Lumina Chronica: books (files, covers, details such as title and author), shelves, projects with characters, places, timeline, lore, files and map, as well as reading progress, bookmarks, favorites, ratings, comments and your reading statistics.
privacy.content.p2: All of it starts out private and visible only to you. We don't look at your content unless a support request, a reported legal violation or fixing a bug requires it.
privacy.public.title: Public content and community
privacy.public.p1: Whatever you make public can be seen by anyone – even without an account:
privacy.public.li1: your profile: username, profile picture, the number of your followers and of people you follow, your public books and projects;
privacy.public.li2: activity on your profile: that you published a book or project or rated a book;
privacy.public.li4: for public projects: characters, relationships, places, timeline, lore and the linked public books – project files and the map stay private.
privacy.public.p2: When you follow someone, rate or comment on a book, the person concerned may receive a notification with your username. If you share a book with a specific person, only they can see it.
privacy.views.title: View counter
privacy.views.p1: When someone opens a public book or project, we count one view. Only the number itself is stored – not who, when or from where. Your own views don't count.
privacy.email.title: Emails
privacy.email.p1: To reset your password and for security notices (such as “Your password was changed”) we send emails through Resend (Resend, Inc., USA). Your email address and the content of the message are transmitted for that. We don't send newsletters or advertising.
privacy.security.title: Protection against abuse
privacy.security.p1: When you sign in, register or reset your password, we briefly store your IP address and the username or email you entered together with an attempt counter, to slow down automated attacks. These entries only apply for a short time window and are then removed by the daily cleanup.
privacy.security.p2: Password reset codes and intermediate steps of signing in with Google or GitHub are deleted at the latest one day after they expire. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in keeping your account secure (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.external.title: External services
privacy.external.p1: Some features use third-party services – only when you use them:
privacy.external.li1: Book data lookup: when you search by ISBN or title while editing a book, your browser queries Open Library (Internet Archive, USA) and Google Books (Google LLC, USA) directly. These providers receive your search term and IP address; preview images are loaded from them.
privacy.external.li2: Bible: Bible texts come from API.Bible (American Bible Society, USA). The requests go through our server; your IP address is not passed on.
privacy.external.li3: Signing in with Google or GitHub: see “Your account”.
privacy.browser.title: Storage in your browser
privacy.browser.p1: Lumina Chronica sets no cookies. Your browser's local storage (localStorage) holds your sign-in token, language, theme and display options; books you make available offline are kept in the browser database IndexedDB.
privacy.browser.p2: This data stays on your device. Signing out removes the sign-in token, offline books can be deleted on the “Offline” page, and your browser settings can remove everything.
privacy.retention.title: Retention and account deletion
privacy.retention.p1: We keep your data as long as your account exists. You can delete your account at any time on your profile.
privacy.retention.p2: Once deleted, your account is deactivated immediately and no longer visible to anyone. For 90 days you can restore it through registration with your username and email address. After that we delete it automatically and for good – including all books, files, projects, shelves, ratings, comments and settings.
privacy.retention.p3: Technical backups of our database provider may contain deleted data for up to 30 more days; they are overwritten automatically after that.
privacy.transfers.title: Transfers to the USA
privacy.transfers.p1: Cloudflare, GitHub, Resend, Google and the Internet Archive are based in the USA. We base transfers there on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework where the provider is certified under it, and otherwise on the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.rights.p1: Under the GDPR you have the right to:
privacy.rights.li1: access the data stored about you (Art. 15),
privacy.rights.li3: erasure (Art. 17) – easiest via “Delete account” on your profile,
privacy.rights.li6: object to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 21),
privacy.rights.li7: lodge a complaint with the Austrian Data Protection Authority (Barichgasse 40–42, 1030 Vienna, dsb.gv.at) or another supervisory authority in the EU.
privacy.rights.p2: For any request, just send us an email:
privacy.changes.title: Changes
privacy.changes.p1: If the app changes so that other data is processed, we update this policy. The date at the top shows the current version.
terms.scope.title: Scope
terms.scope.p1: These terms apply to using Lumina Chronica, a private, non-commercial and free project by Matthias Watzinger (see Legal Notice).
terms.scope.p2: By registering you agree to these terms. How we handle your data is described in the privacy policy.
terms.account.title: Your account
terms.account.li1: You must be at least 14 years old.
terms.account.li2: Use an email address that belongs to you – otherwise you can't reset your password.
terms.account.li3: Keep your password secret. You are responsible for everything that happens through your account.
terms.content.title: Your content
terms.content.p1: Everything you upload or write stays yours. You only grant us the rights needed to run the service: to store your content, show it to you and – if you make it public or share it – show it to others. These rights end when you delete the content or your account.
terms.content.p2: You are responsible for your own content. Please keep copies of important files elsewhere too – Lumina Chronica is not a backup service.
terms.copyright.title: Copyright
terms.copyright.p1: Books and files are usually protected by copyright. Therefore:
terms.copyright.li1: Privately, just for yourself, you may upload books you lawfully own – for example to read and organise them here.
terms.copyright.li2: You may only make public or share works you hold the rights to (for example your own texts and images) or that are in the public domain.
terms.copyright.li3: The same applies to covers, images and files in projects.
terms.rules.title: What's not allowed
terms.rules.p1: In particular, the following are not allowed:
terms.rules.li1: unlawful content, such as infringements of copyright or personality rights;
terms.rules.li2: hate speech, harassment, threats or content glorifying violence;
terms.rules.li3: other people's personal data without their consent;
terms.rules.li4: malware, spam or attempts to disrupt the app or bypass security measures;
terms.report.title: Reporting violations
terms.report.p1: If you see public content that violates your rights or the law, please email us with:
terms.report.li1: the link to the book, project, profile or comment concerned,
terms.report.li2: a short description of what is unlawful about it,
terms.report.li3: for copyright: who holds the rights and how we can reach you.
terms.report.p2: We review every report and remove unlawful content promptly. Accounts of people who repeatedly break these terms may be suspended.
terms.availability.title: Availability
terms.availability.p1: Lumina Chronica is free and run in spare time. We aim for reliable operation but cannot promise constant availability.
terms.availability.p2: Features may change or be removed. Should the project be discontinued, we will announce it in good time so you can download your content.
terms.liability.title: Liability
terms.liability.p1: We are liable without limitation for intent and gross negligence and for personal injury. Otherwise liability is excluded as far as the law permits – in particular for data loss and for content by other users.
terms.ending.title: Ending your account
terms.ending.p1: You can delete your account at any time on your profile. It can be restored for 90 days, after which it is deleted for good (see privacy policy).
terms.ending.p2: In case of serious or repeated violations of these terms we may remove content and suspend your account.
terms.changes.title: Changes and applicable law
terms.changes.p1: We may adapt these terms when the app changes. We will announce significant changes in the app.
terms.changes.p2: Austrian law applies. Mandatory consumer protection rules of your country of residence remain unaffected.
